name: openbb_etf_search
description:
Search ETFs by name or keyword through the OpenBB Platform (obb.etf.search).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): query*; provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts fmp or intrinio; schema default fmp, but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it).
Fund facts: openbb_etf_info, yf_etf_info; keyless symbol search: yahoo_search_symbols. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"query": "dividend", "provider": "fmp"}
